visual.description: Primary white background used across most page sections.
Very light blue-grey used as alternate section and card backgrounds.
Deep navy used for primary headings and the logo wordmark.
Dark slate used for body copy and paragraph text.
Medium slate-blue used for secondary labels, captions, and subdued text.
Vivid violet-blue used as the primary CTA button fill and brand accent.
Lighter periwinkle used for secondary links and accents.
Very light violet used as a soft secondary button background.
Pale lavender used for borders on white-background buttons and cards.
Acid green used for display headings — a charged accent against the white ground.
Blue-grey used for subdued body text and secondary nav items.
